info.title: AIBUS Public Booking API
info.description: Outward-facing AIBUS integration-test API. Uses CRS inventory, pricing, booking, cancellation and refund workflows in a dedicated non-production database. Payments and refunds use Razorpay Test Mode only; no real money or production tickets are issued. Partner access requires explicit inventory grants. Holds last at most 5 minutes; quotes at most 2 minutes and never beyond the hold. Idempotency keys are partner-global and content-bound. A cancellation request requires operator review; test refunds are handled by the existing refund worker. Rescheduling and partner wallets return 501.
